FR-M2: partly built: the read models class every actor as a person (with persona), an agent role with its model, or the kernel (kernel.dashboard.activity), and the page draws a person badge, a bot or a diamond from that class; criterion evidence states (claimed, verified, held out, FR-O6-AC-3) and verdicts are shown by tone, icon and word; not built: the brief's grammar itself (agent circle, deterministic diamond and person hexagon by shape and colour; fill for declared, evidenced and verified assurance; the state icon set passed, running, insufficient, blocked and not measured; solid versus dashed lines for the artifact and control channels), with no shared grammar module the views draw from, and the page's drawing is JavaScript the stdlib test suite does not run
FR-M4: partly built: the dashboard's headline figures carry observed or derived provenance, the sentence that says how each was counted and its numerator and denominator, and a verified criterion names the gate (task, round, revision) behind it (FR-O6-AC-3); not built: a number does not open the ledger records (sequence numbers or hashes) it was counted from, no figure is ever marked proxy, and the figures outside the headline row (Floor rates, spend, queue ages, model reliability) carry no provenance tag; it would take each read model returning its method and the records it read
FR-M5: not built: no read model or cockpit route takes a past moment; every ledger record carries a sequence number and a time, but cards, tasks.json and project metadata are mutable files, so replay would need each view rebuilt from ledger events up to a chosen sequence or time
FR-M7: partly built: a canary abort rolls the candidate back and opens a blocking incident card for operations, IT or a developer (as does a failing production probe, FR-I2); not built: alerts for a stalled cell, the approval queue over a target, budget burn over a forecast, gate flapping, an invariant breach (a broken ledger chain or a tampered Gnomon run is marked, not alerted) and quota contention, since no alert rule, target, budget, forecast or notifier exists; a lesson class recurring in a second project opens a default-check proposal (FR-K3), but the recurrence of a closed failure class is not raised as an alert
